name: iso_country_lookup
description: Look up a country by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3 or numeric code or by English name, or find the countries that use a time zone, an ISO 4217 currency or an ITU-T E.164 calling code. Each answer gives the codes, English names, current currencies, calling codes and IANA time zones from a bundled dated table (tz database 2026e, public domain; Unicode CLDR 48.2 and the CLDR 33.1 telephone codes, Unicode License) and names its sources. No capitals.

name.description: English name; case and accents ignored, a partial name returns candidates

catalog.source: original; table built by tools/catalog/data/iso_country_lookup.py from the IANA tz database 2026e (iso3166.tab, zone.tab, zone1970.tab), Unicode CLDR 48.2 (supplementalData.xml codeMappings and currencyData, main/en.xml) and CLDR 33.1 telephoneCodeData.xml
